name: Firing-rate audit (TokenEconomizer idea TE-T4)
summary: An offline transcript scan that flags owned rules and memory entries that never change behavior, so always-loaded text can shrink instead of only growing. A design idea from TokenEconomizer, not measured anywhere. Planned for v8.2; running memory-lint by hand is the simpler alternative.

evidence.effect: Rules that never fire could be removed to cut always-loaded tokens (expected, not measured)

killTest.hypothesis: Rules that never fire can be removed safely
killTest.pass: A removed rule is rediscovered in fewer than 2 of the next 10 sessions
killTest.ifFails: That kind of removal isn't proposed again
killTest.scheduled: v8.2 (maintenance automation); its exit criteria require K-TE-T4 to have run

maintenance: Owned engine feature, maintained with the engine.
